opening.argument: The presentation leads with an unusually large and rapid earning claim: “Earn Daily Rs.5000 Paytm Cash Without Investment.” It then directs viewers through online tasks involving Facebook pages and submission, while the displayed withdrawal screen requests extensive personal and banking information, including a bank name, card number, IFSC code, email, and withdrawal amount. The account dashboard also presents task rewards alongside referral and team rewards, without showing completed values. Any displayed payment evidence therefore does not establish a successful payout or connect that payment to the promoted service, leaving the promised path to account or bank-account credit unsupported.
